items.raw_excerpt: British photographer Katie Edwards has likely taken more photographs of Germany through train windows than anyone else. She spoke to The Local about her project, and the ups and down of travelling with Deutsche Bahn.
items.summary_en: British photographer Katie Edwards has taken countless photos of Germany through train windows. She shares her project and stories about traveling with Deutsche Bahn.
items.summary_ko: 영국 사진작가 케이티 에드워즈는 독일 기차 창밖으로 수많은 사진을 찍어왔다. 그녀는 자신의 프로젝트와 도이치반 여행 이야기를 공유했다.
items.title_en: Meet the woman who photographed Germany from its trains
items.title_ko: 독일 기차 창밖으로 사진 찍는 여성

items.raw_excerpt: There are lots of ways to use this short Italian word.
items.summary_en: This article explores different meanings of the Italian word 'sacco'. The word has several interpretations used in everyday Italian conversation.
items.summary_ko: 이 기사는 이탈리아어 단어 'sacco'의 다양한 의미와 용법을 소개합니다. 이 단어는 일상적인 이탈리아어 대화에서 여러 가지로 사용됩니다.

items.raw_excerpt: On September 6th, the Danish parliament invites anyone who received citizenship in 2025 to their annual statsborgsskabdag (or “citizenship day” in English) at Christiansborg palace.
items.summary_en: On September 6th the Danish parliament will host its annual Citizenship Day at Christiansborg Palace in Copenhagen. Anyone who became a Danish citizen in 2025 is invited to attend the event.
items.summary_ko: 덴마크 의회가 9월 6일 크리스티안스보르궁에서 연례 시민의 날 행사를 개최합니다. 2025년에 덴마크 시민이 된 모든 사람을 초대합니다.
items.title_en: Denmark's parliament to welcome new citizens at annual Citizenship Day
